paper.title: Genome modelling and design across all domains of life with Evo 2

generators.name: Evo 2 autoregressive generation
generators.description: Propose 128-bp continuations from the retained regulatory sequence prompts with the 7B Evo 2 model.

evidence.quote: We sample 128-bp chunks from the Evo 2 7B model with temperature 1.0 and top-k 4.

constraints.name: Enformer chromatin pattern loss
constraints.description: Compare normalized Enformer chromatin-accessibility output with the requested binary pattern and retain this model loss separately.

evidence.quote: We define the Enformer objective as the L1 distance between the target pattern and the normalized Enformer prediction.

constraints.name: Borzoi chromatin pattern loss
constraints.description: Compare the target pattern with the lower-confidence-bound signal from the four-model Borzoi ensemble and retain this loss separately.

evidence.quote: We combine the four Borzoi model replicates using a lower confidence bound, computed as the mean minus the standard deviation.

optimizers.name: chunked beam search
optimizers.description: At each 128-bp iteration, score 42 chunks for each of two retained prompts using both predictive objectives, then retain the top two.

evidence.quote: For the main design experiments, we use K = 42 sampled chunks per retained prompt and retain K-prime = 2 prompts after each iteration.
We sample 128-bp chunks from the Evo 2 7B model with temperature 1.0 and top-k 4.
Enformer takes a 196,608-bp input sequence and predicts 896 bins at 128-bp resolution.
Borzoi takes a 524,288-bp input sequence and predicts 6,144 bins at 32-bp resolution.

steps.operation: Sample Evo 2 continuations for each retained prompt

evidence.quote: The final objective is f(x) = 0.5(f_Enformer(x) + f_Borzoi(x)).

assumptions: The two named constraint outputs form the joint surrogate target vector; their 0.5 weights reproduce the paper's ranking scalarization up to Proto's mean-versus-sum factor.
Proto's mean absolute error has the same candidate ordering as the paper L1 sum when the scored output length is fixed.
The smoke variant reduces only the target length and proposal count; it is a wiring test and has no paper-comparable AUROC.
BeamSearchOptimizer seed 0 controls local proposal selection, but Evo2Generator itself exposes no seed parameter.
Every full-Proto versus fused-Proto comparison uses the same BeamSearchOptimizer seed; Evo 2 model-internal seed control remains explicitly false in both arms.
unknowns: The paper does not disclose a model-generation random seed.
The exact 40,960-bp mm39 prompt sequence and downstream right-flank sequence are not embedded in the paper text; ACGT/A are explicit non-comparable placeholders.
The exact 129 ES-E14 Enformer and Borzoi track identifiers were not recovered; local mouse defaults [11] and [741] are implementation placeholders.
Proto scores mean absolute error while the paper reports an L1 sum; raw score magnitudes therefore require multiplication by the number of scored bins before direct comparison.
